one_liner: Mookie Betts lived on contact more than raw power in 2025: his 90th-percentile exit velocity was 100.8 mph, the lowest top-end in this group.
three_things: The bat-to-ball skill showed up in volume: 814 batted balls over 2,420 pitches seen.
Average exit velocity 84.7 mph, .329 estimated wOBA on contact.
Four-seam fastballs were 31.7% of his diet; 51.1% of pitches were in the rulebook zone.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). These are contact-quality numbers only -- they say nothing about his on-base skill, baserunning, or defense. The contact figures are over the 814 batted balls, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model that ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Lowest top-end' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
